title: Feature request: dates in careportal
symptom: In the care portal, information is separated by day by a gray bar containing text. The first 7 days feature vague texts such as 'today', 'yesterday', '2 days ago', etc., making it difficult to determine the exact date without calculation. Starting from the 8th day, hard dates appear.
fix: The thread suggests replacing the vague indications with hard dates, possibly supplemented with weekday names for the first 7 days. A commit was referenced as a resolution.
evidence_quote: Proposal to replace the vague indications above the first 7 days with a hard date. Perhaps supplement this for the first 7 days with "Monday", "Tuesday", etc.
